ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid='door-self-card-relationship'] (parent1, who has a completed cp assessment) does NOT open the cp-assess-modal in multiple Playwright runs. No [role='dialog'] appears after click. Dismissing the Legal-Ack modal first did not help. The wiring in JourneyShell.jsx:1518 is a simple setCpAssessOpen(true) and the modal is mounted at :1796 — so either (a) a legal-ack / stacked overlay is swallowing the click despite force=True, or (b) cpAssessOpen is being reset by a side-effect. Needs manual self-test by the main agent — likely a flaky overlay interaction rather than product bug, since the modal, hook and parts (CpIntro/CpSection/CpResults) all have correct testids and code paths.

grep across /app/frontend/src confirms that AlignmentHub is defined (AlignmentHub.jsx) but ONLY its named export GreyRockToggleChip is imported anywhere; the AlignmentHub component itself and its CpProgressTile child (which renders [data-testid='cp-progress-extras'] with include-safety / include-biff checkboxes + warnings + download href rewriting) are never rendered in any route. Routes tried: /dashboard, /alignment-tools, /dashboard?open=alignment-tools — none expose the extras. So the Mediator tick-boxes feature backend is live but the UI entry is unreachable to users. Need to mount <AlignmentHub hideCourtOnly … /> (or lift CpProgressTile out) on the Alignment & Tools surface in JourneyShell/SacoparentsPortal.

issues: Still occasionally re-appears on Self-Journey navigation and intercepts clicks (pre-existing, carried over from iter91).

action_items: CRITICAL: Mount <AlignmentHub hideCourtOnly={true} …/> (or at minimum <CpProgressTile …/>) on a reachable surface so the Mediator PDF extras tick-boxes (cp-progress-extras / include_safety / include_biff) become usable in the UI. Currently the backend ?include_safety=true / ?include_biff=true endpoints are correct, but there is no frontend entry point.

Manually verify door-self-card-relationship opens cp-assess-modal in the browser; if reproducible, inspect whether the Legal-Ack dialog is stealing focus/click or whether cpAssessOpen is being toggled off by a sibling effect. The roadmap step action at line 1008 also calls openDoor('self') + setCpAssessOpen(true), which could cause a re-render race if invoked from the roadmap entry.

Good.

self_assessment_routes.py _goal_practice — recent_dates uses dates[-60:] (last 60), ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings. Returned by both /history and /goal/checkin as spec.

CRITICAL dead-code: AlignmentHub component is only used for its GreyRockToggleChip named export; the full component (which contains the newly-added ProgressExtras tick-boxes) is never rendered anywhere, making the Mediator extras UI unreachable. Either mount it or extract CpProgressTile into the live JourneyShell/SacoparentsPortal surface.

CoparentingAssessmentModal is well-structured; good testid coverage on intro/section/results/footer; useCoparentingAssessment hook mode transitions look sound. UI non-open issue above is almost certainly environmental not structural.
